findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "buscar_empresa_por_cnpj" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Busca dados cadastrais de uma empresa brasileira pelo CNPJ." → after: "(hash e3b0c442)"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
